_about: Ryu inputs for scripts/recompute.py, verified Sept 28, 2026 (patch state: latest Ryu change Aug 3, 2026). Single-hit values are Capcom official. Multi-hit meaties are derived from SuperCombo per-hit data (active windows, per-hit blockstun/hitstun, total); published in-game values are kept as cross-checks. Re-run the freshness and patch-drift checks before reusing.

6MP._note: Post Mar 17, 2026 (2nd-hit blockstun 21 -> 19, SuperCombo revs 357767 -> 358561). With the pre-patch blockstun 21 the same derivation gives the 2025 notes' 0/+1, which confirms the method.

HP Hashogeki.label: fixed two-hit sequence
HP Hashogeki._note: Two hits: 30-34 then 35 (Capcom '30-34.35'); SuperCombo: '2 hits, even if it connects on final active frame'. The final hit always lands on move frame 35 wherever the first connects, so block advantage is fixed at +2 for every contact c = 1..6 (published at R29, 32, 33).
